service.advanced.asIs.note: Why advanced.json can't be used, in English (kept from before Combwork translated it). Keep it as {problem} alone.

service.advanced.changedOutside.text: advanced.json was changed outside Combwork meanwhile: Settings shows it now. Try again.
service.advanced.changedOutside.note: An error changing an advanced setting: advanced.json (a file name: keep it) was edited elsewhere meanwhile, so the change wasn't written.

service.advanced.fixFirst.text: {problem} Fix advanced.json (Settings → Advanced → Open advanced.json) before changing settings here.
service.advanced.fixFirst.note: An error changing an advanced setting while advanced.json (a file name: keep it) can't be read; {problem} says why, a sentence. Settings → Advanced → Open advanced.json is where to open it: use its translated names.

service.advanced.fixOrDelete.text: {problem} Fix or delete advanced.json first (Settings → Advanced → Open advanced.json).
service.advanced.fixOrDelete.note: An error resetting every advanced setting while advanced.json (a file name: keep it) can't be read; {problem} says why, a sentence. Settings → Advanced → Open advanced.json is where to open it: use its translated names.

service.advanced.newer.text: advanced.json is from a newer Combwork (format {format}): this one reads format {supported}.
service.advanced.newer.note: Above Settings → Advanced's list: advanced.json (a file name: keep it) was written by a newer version of Combwork, in a format ({format}) this one can't read ({supported} is the one it reads).

service.advanced.notJson.note: Above Settings → Advanced's list: Combwork's advanced settings file (advanced.json, a file name: keep it) can't be read as JSON; {error} is the JSON reader's own words (English, with no full stop of its own). A sentence of its own: more follows it.

service.advanced.notObject.note: Above Settings → Advanced's list: advanced.json (a file name: keep it) holds JSON that isn't an object; {example} is what it should look like (JSON: keep it).

service.advanced.notValues.text: advanced.json's "values" should be an object of setting → value.
service.advanced.notValues.note: Above Settings → Advanced's list: the "values" field of advanced.json (keep both as they are) isn't a set of settings and their values.

service.advanced.onConnection.text: "{id}" is set on each connection now: Settings → Accounts & Connections, a connection's ⋯ menu, Launch Settings.
service.advanced.onConnection.note: An error changing an advanced setting (HI-2670): this one moved to each connection's launch settings. {id} is the setting's id; Settings → Accounts & Connections and Launch Settings are where it is now: use their translated names.

service.advanced.unknown.note: An error changing an advanced setting: Combwork has none with the id {id}.

service.attachments.badFolder.note: An error: a name given for a session's attachments folder isn't one Combwork makes (a session id).

service.attachments.badRecord.text: {file} is not a record of moved files
service.attachments.badRecord.note: An error: the file {file} where Combwork records attachments it renamed can't be read as one (damaged).

service.attachments.notOwn.text: {folder} is a link or not a folder of the project's own, so Combwork keeps no attachments in it.
service.attachments.notOwn.note: An error keeping a pasted or dropped file for a session: its folder {folder} (in the project's .combwork) is a link or leads elsewhere, so Combwork writes nothing through it.

service.benchmarks.allPinned.text: {n} are kept and all are pinned: unpin or remove one first.
service.benchmarks.allPinned.note: An error keeping a comparison on the Performance page: the most that can be kept ({n}) are kept, all pinned, so none can make room.

service.benchmarks.cantRead.text: The kept comparisons can’t be read: {error}
service.benchmarks.cantRead.note: An error on the Performance page: the list of kept comparisons (benchmarks kept to compare) can't be read; {error} is why (the system's words).

service.benchmarks.closed.text: The workspace was closed or switched: nothing was changed.
service.benchmarks.closed.note: An error on the Performance page: the workspace closed, or another opened in its window, while kept comparisons were being changed; nothing changed.

service.benchmarks.damaged.text: That comparison file is missing or damaged: remove it and import it again.
service.benchmarks.damaged.note: An error on the Performance page: a kept comparison's file can't be read.

service.benchmarks.noSuch.note: An error on the Performance page: the kept comparison asked for is not there.

service.benchmarks.noSuchHere.text: No such comparison for this scope
service.benchmarks.noSuchHere.note: An error on the Performance page: the kept comparison asked for isn't one of the scope shown (the workspace, or a project).

service.benchmarks.noWorkspace.note: An error on the Performance page: kept comparisons need a workspace open.

service.benchmarks.notRemoved.text: It is off the list, but its file couldn’t be removed yet: Combwork will try again.
service.benchmarks.notRemoved.note: An error removing a kept comparison on the Performance page: it is no longer listed, but its file couldn't be deleted yet.

service.benchmarks.stuck.text: {n, plural, one {# removed comparison’s file couldn’t be deleted yet (in use?): nothing more can be kept until it is.} other {# removed comparisons’ files couldn’t be deleted yet (in use?): nothing more can be kept until they are.}} Combwork retries each time it reads the list.
service.benchmarks.stuck.note: An error keeping a comparison on the Performance page: {n} removed comparisons' files couldn't be deleted yet (another program may have them open), and the list has no room until they are.

service.benchmarks.switched.text: The workspace was switched: nothing was kept.
service.benchmarks.switched.note: An error keeping the Performance page's report as a comparison: the window opened another workspace meanwhile.

service.benchmarks.unwritable.text: Combwork refused to write a list of kept comparisons it couldn’t read back: nothing was changed.
service.benchmarks.unwritable.note: An error on the Performance page: the list of kept comparisons Combwork was about to write wouldn't read back as valid, so it wasn't written.

service.benchmarks.why.text: {why, select, missing {the list of kept comparisons was missing} damaged {the list of kept comparisons was damaged} entry {an entry of the list of kept comparisons was damaged} other {the list of kept comparisons had too many entries}}
service.benchmarks.why.note: Why Combwork rebuilt the list of kept comparisons from their files: it was missing, damaged, had a damaged entry, or had too many entries. A clause, lower case (it follows "Recovered:").

service.benchmarks.wrongScope.text: That comparison file doesn’t match its scope: remove it and import it again.
service.benchmarks.wrongScope.note: An error on the Performance page: a kept comparison's file is of another scope than its entry in the list says.

service.cardAttach.moveFailed.text: The card's attachments couldn't be copied to {project}, so it wasn't moved: {why}
service.cardAttach.moveFailed.note: An error moving a card to another project (HI-1700): its attached files couldn't be copied there; the card stays where it was. {project} is the project's name, {why} the reason.

service.cardAttach.moved.text: The card moved to another project meanwhile: attach again.
service.cardAttach.moved.note: An error attaching files to a card (HI-1700): the card moved to another project while they were copied; nothing was attached.

service.cardAttach.noAttachment.text: The card has no such attachment.
service.cardAttach.noAttachment.note: An error removing a card attachment (HI-1700) that is gone.

service.cardAttach.noCard.note: An error attaching a file to a card (HI-1700): the card is gone.

service.cardAttach.noProject.text: {project} is not a project of the workspace. Nothing was attached.
service.cardAttach.noProject.note: An error attaching files to a card (HI-1700): the project named for it is not one of the workspace’s (a path, or a name no project has); nothing was copied.

service.cardAttach.refused.text: {path} is not a file that can be attached here: give the path of a file of your own project (its folder, its slots) or of the temp folder. Nothing was attached.
service.cardAttach.refused.note: An error attaching a file to a card by its path (HI-1700): it is missing, a folder or a link, or in a place the caller may not attach from (another project, Combwork’s own folders). Nothing was attached.

service.cardAttach.refusedFrom.text: {path} is not a file that can be attached here. Files can come from {caller, select, agent {your own project (its folder, its slots)} other {the workspace and its projects}}, the temp folder ({temp}){more, select, yes { and the folders of Settings → Advanced → Card attachments: more folders ({folders})} other {}}. To attach from another folder, the user adds it there (Settings → Advanced → Card attachments: more folders, Combwork's or this workspace's): don't copy the file into the temp folder. Nothing was attached.
service.cardAttach.refusedFrom.note: An error attaching a file to a card by its path (HI-1700, HI-2480): it is missing, a folder or a link, or in a place the caller may not attach from. {caller} is agent for a project's agent, else the Assistant or a script; {temp} is the temp folder's path; {more} is yes when the user listed more folders, {folders} those folders. Card attachments: more folders is an advanced setting's title: use it as Settings shows it. Nothing was attached.

service.cardAttach.tooLarge.text: {name} is larger than {max}, the most a card keeps in one file (Settings → Advanced → Card attachments: largest file). Nothing was attached.
service.cardAttach.tooLarge.note: An error attaching files to a card (HI-1700): one is larger than the limit ({max}: a size such as 25 MB); none of them was attached.

service.cardAttach.tooMuch.text: At most {files, number} files and {total} can be attached at once. Nothing was attached.
service.cardAttach.tooMuch.note: An error attaching files to a card (HI-1700): more files, or more bytes in all ({total}: a size such as 100 MB), than one change takes; none was attached.

service.cardCleanup.stale.text: This list is out of date: nothing was removed. Open Clean Up Now again.
service.cardCleanup.stale.note: An error of Clean Up Now (Project Settings → Storage, HI-1842): the list of archived cards' files it showed expired, was used already, or belongs to a workspace closed since; nothing was removed.

service.combworkMove.busy.text: Another Combwork is moving this workspace's old data folders to .combwork ({profile}). Open it again once it has finished.
service.combworkMove.busy.note: An error opening a workspace (HI-2462): another copy of the app ({profile}: its profile folder's name) is renaming the workspace's old data folders to .combwork now. Keep .combwork as it is.

service.combworkMove.closed.text: The workspace was closed while Combwork was moving its old data folders to .combwork. Open it again to finish.
service.combworkMove.closed.note: An error opening a workspace (HI-2462): it was closed, or another was opened in its window, during the rename of its old data folders to .combwork. Keep .combwork as it is.

service.combworkMove.locked.text: Combwork couldn't move {folder} to .combwork: a program has a file in it open. Close that program (or another Combwork, or a 1.0 copy, using this workspace), then open the workspace again. Nothing was lost.
service.combworkMove.locked.note: An error opening a workspace (HI-2462): its old data folder, renamed .combwork in this version, couldn't be renamed because a file in it is open. {folder} is the folder. A 1.0 copy: the app's version 1.0, from before it was renamed. Keep .combwork as it is (a folder name).

service.combworkMove.otherOpen.text: This workspace is open in another Combwork or a 1.0 copy ({profile}). Close it there, then open it here: Combwork moves its old data folders to .combwork first.
service.combworkMove.otherOpen.note: An error opening a workspace (HI-2462): another copy of the app ({profile}: its profile folder's name; a 1.0 copy: the app's version 1.0, from before it was renamed) has it open, so its old data folders can't be renamed .combwork now. Keep .combwork as it is.

service.combworkMove.phaseFailed.text: Combwork moved this workspace's old data folders to .combwork, but couldn't finish updating {what}: {error} Open the workspace again to finish.
service.combworkMove.phaseFailed.note: An error opening a workspace (HI-2462): its old data folders were renamed .combwork, but a step after that failed; the next open finishes it. {what} is what it was updating (main.combworkMove.what.*); {error} says why, a sentence. Keep .combwork as it is.

service.combworkVcs.cantList.text: Git couldn't list the files it tracks in .combwork.
service.combworkVcs.cantList.note: An error untracking the project's .combwork folder from git: git couldn't list them. Keep .combwork as it is (a folder name).

service.combworkVcs.cantListWhy.text: Git couldn't list the files it tracks in .combwork ({problem}).
service.combworkVcs.cantListWhy.note: An error untracking the project's .combwork folder from git: git can't run; {problem} says why ("Git isn't installed"). Keep .combwork as it is (a folder name).

service.combworkVcs.changed.text: The files git tracks in .combwork changed since you were shown them: nothing was untracked. Look again.
service.combworkVcs.changed.note: An error untracking the project's .combwork folder from git: the list of its tracked files changed after Combwork showed it, so nothing changed. Keep .combwork as it is.

service.combworkVcs.exitCode.note: Why a git command failed when git said nothing: the number it exited with.

service.combworkVcs.noRepo.text: No git repository holds this project.
service.combworkVcs.noRepo.note: An error untracking the project's .combwork folder (Combwork's own files) from git: the project isn't in a git repository.

service.combworkVcs.rmFailed.note: An error untracking the project's .combwork folder from git: the git command (git rm --cached: keep it) failed; {why} is git's own first line, or why git can't run.

service.files.badName.note: An error making or renaming a file or folder: {name} is empty, . or .., or has a character Windows can't have in a name.

service.files.exists.note: An error making or renaming a file or folder in the Files tab: one called {name} is already there.

service.files.existsIn.text: {root, select, yes {"{name}" already exists in the project root} other {"{name}" already exists in {folder}}}
service.files.existsIn.note: An error moving files: the folder they go to already has one called {name}. {root} is yes when that folder is the project's own (its root), else {folder} is its path in the project.

service.files.groupInUse.text: Another program has one of these files open. Close it, then try again.
service.files.groupInUse.note: An error deleting a session's attachments: another program has one of them open, so none was moved.

service.files.inUse.text: Another program has this file open. Close it, then try again.
service.files.inUse.note: An error deleting a session's attachment: another program has the file open, so Windows won't move it.

service.files.insideItself.note: An error moving a folder ({name}) into itself, or into a folder inside it.

service.files.nameRequired.note: An error making a file or folder with no name.

service.files.needsEntry.text: This action needs a file or folder inside the project
service.files.needsEntry.note: An error in the Files tab: the action (rename, move, delete…) was given the project's own folder, not something in it.

service.files.notAttachment.note: An error opening or deleting a session's attachment: the path isn't a file in a session's attachments folder.

service.files.notKept.text: Not one of the session attachments Combwork keeps.
service.files.notKept.note: An error deleting a session's attachment (a file pasted or dropped into a session): it isn't one Combwork keeps, or it is a link.

service.files.outside.note: An error in the Files tab: a file's path leads out of the project.

service.files.throughLink.text: Path leads outside the project (through a link)
service.files.throughLink.note: An error in the Files tab: a file's path goes through a link (a symbolic link or junction) to somewhere outside the project.

service.filesGit.busy.text: Another git command is using the repository. Try again in a moment.
service.filesGit.busy.note: An error from the Files tab's Git menu: git's index is locked by another git command (an agent's commit, say).

service.filesGit.failed.note: An error from the Files tab's Git menu. {why} is git's own message (English).

service.filesGit.linked.text: {file} is a link, or leads outside the repository, so Combwork leaves it alone. Change it by hand.
service.filesGit.linked.note: An error from the Files tab's Git menu (HI-2743): the ignore file ({file}: .gitignore or .git/info/exclude) is a symbolic link or junction, or its folder leads outside the repository, so Combwork won't write through it.

service.filesGit.notIgnored.note: An error from the Files tab's Git menu: the file isn't ignored any more.

service.filesGit.notRepo.text: This project is not a git repository.
service.filesGit.notRepo.note: An error from the Files tab's Git menu (HI-2743): the project folder isn't in a git repository.

service.filesGit.notUtf8.text: {file} is not UTF-8 text, so Combwork leaves it alone.
service.filesGit.notUtf8.note: An error from the Files tab's Git menu: the ignore file ({file}) isn't UTF-8, so Combwork won't rewrite it.

service.filesGit.nothing.text: Choose a file or folder in the project.
service.filesGit.nothing.note: An error from the Files tab's Git menu: it was given nothing to act on.

service.filesGit.ruleChanged.text: The rule that ignores it has changed. Look again with Why is this ignored?.
service.filesGit.ruleChanged.note: An error from Include again in the Files tab's Git menu: the line it would remove isn't there any more, or it isn't one Combwork can remove. Why is this ignored? is the menu item (files.git.why).

service.filesGit.tooLarge.text: {file} is too large to show here.
service.filesGit.tooLarge.note: An error from Why Is This Ignored? in the Files tab's Git menu: the rule's file ({file}) is too large to show in Combwork's viewer.

service.folderChanges.agentBusy.text: {agent} is working in {folder}. Try again once it has finished.
service.folderChanges.agentBusy.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside: an agent ({agent}) works in the folder ({folder}, a path); nothing was done.

service.folderChanges.busy.text: An agent or a run is working in {folder} ({what}). Try again once it has finished.
service.folderChanges.busy.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside: an agent holds files or a run works in the folder ({folder}, a path); {what} names the first file or run's folder; nothing was done.

service.folderChanges.changed.text: The changes in {folder} aren't the ones shown any more. Look again.
service.folderChanges.changed.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside: a file shown is no longer changed in the folder ({folder}, a path), or none was shown; nothing was done.

service.folderChanges.commitFailed.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit: git (or a hook, or signing) refused the commit; {why} is its own message (English). The files are as they were.

service.folderChanges.commitTimedOut.text: Git didn't finish the commit in {seconds, number} seconds (a hook still running, or signing waiting for an answer), so Combwork ended it and everything it had started. The files and the index are as they were.
service.folderChanges.commitTimedOut.note: HI-3021: an error from Commit (a paused merge, a start's warning) or Files' Commit it: git's commit ran past its time limit ({seconds}) and Combwork ended it with its hook; nothing was committed, and the files and git's index (staging area) are unchanged. Keep git as it is.

service.folderChanges.deletedKept.text: {file} is staged for removal from Git: commit it yourself in Git; Combwork won't add it back.
service.folderChanges.deletedKept.note: HI-2982: an error from Commit or Set aside (a paused merge, a start's warning): the file ({file}, a path) had its removal from Git staged (Files' Stop Tracking) and is still on disk; git's commit or stash would put it back, so nothing was done. The user commits the removal in Git themselves.

service.folderChanges.detached.text: {folder} isn't on a branch, so Combwork doesn't commit there.
service.folderChanges.detached.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit it (Files) or Commit: the folder ({folder}, a path) has a detached HEAD (git's term), so nothing is committed.

service.folderChanges.indexBusy.text: Another git command is using the repository. Try again in a moment.
service.folderChanges.indexBusy.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside: git's index is locked by another git command.

service.folderChanges.indexNotTaken.text: {action, select, commit {Git made the commit ({made})} other {Git set the changes aside in a stash ({made})}}, but Combwork couldn't update the index for those files afterwards: {why}. Until it's updated, git status may show them as changed in the index: once no git command is running, run git reset on them.
service.folderChanges.indexNotTaken.note: HI-3021: an error from Commit or Set aside (a paused merge, a start's warning): git committed (or stashed) the files ({made}, a commit or stash id), but updating git's index (staging area) for them afterwards failed; {why} is git's own message (English), often another git command holding the index. {action} is commit or setAside. Keep git status and git reset as they are: commands.

service.folderChanges.midOperation.text: Git is in the middle of {state, select, merge {a merge} rebase {a rebase} cherryPick {a cherry-pick} other {a revert}} in {folder}. Finish or abort it first.
service.folderChanges.midOperation.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside: a git operation is under way in the folder ({folder}, a path); nothing was done.

service.folderChanges.moved.text: Where {target} is checked out changed meanwhile. Look again.
service.folderChanges.moved.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside: the folder the branch {target} is checked out in changed while Combwork waited to act; nothing was done.

service.folderChanges.nestedRepo.text: {folder} is a Git repository of its own inside this one, so Combwork doesn't commit it or set it aside. Add it to .gitignore, or as a submodule, yourself.
service.folderChanges.nestedRepo.note: HI-2983: an error from Commit or Set aside (a paused merge, a start's warning): one of the changes shown ({folder}, a folder path ending in /) is an untracked folder that is a Git repository of its own; nothing was done. Keep .gitignore: a file name.

service.folderChanges.noTarget.text: {target} isn't checked out in a folder of this project now: nothing to commit or set aside there.
service.folderChanges.noTarget.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside (a paused merge, a start's warning): the branch {target} isn't checked out anywhere now.

service.folderChanges.nothing.note: HI-2944: an error from Files' Commit it after Exclude from Git: the ignore file ({file}, such as .gitignore) has no uncommitted change.

service.folderChanges.readFailed.text: Git could not read the folder's changes: {why}
service.folderChanges.readFailed.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside: git status failed; {why} is git's own message (English). Nothing was done.

service.folderChanges.stashFailed.text: Git did not set the changes aside: {why}
service.folderChanges.stashFailed.note: HI-2944: an error from Set aside: git refused to stash the changes; {why} is its own message (English). The files are as they were.

service.folderChanges.stashPartial.text: Git reported a problem while setting the changes aside, after keeping them in a stash ({stash}). Check git stash list and the files before going on. Git said: {why}
service.folderChanges.stashPartial.note: HI-2944: an error from Set aside: git stashed the changes (the stash's id, {stash}) but then failed; the user checks the stash and the files. {why} is git's own message (English). Keep git stash list as it is: a command.

service.folderChanges.stashTimedOut.text: Git didn't finish setting the changes aside in {seconds, number} seconds, so Combwork ended it and everything it had started.{made, select, yes { It had kept them in a stash ({stash}) by then.} other {}} Check git stash list and the files before going on.
service.folderChanges.stashTimedOut.note: HI-3021: an error from Set aside (a paused merge, a start's warning): git stash ran past its time limit ({seconds}) and Combwork ended it. {made} is yes when git had made a stash ({stash}, its id) by then. Keep git stash list as it is: a command.

service.folderChanges.tooManyToSetAside.text: Git can't set aside this many files ({count, number}) at once in {folder}. Commit them, or set them aside with git stash yourself.
service.folderChanges.tooManyToSetAside.note: HI-2983: an error from Set aside (a paused merge, a start's warning): too many files ({count}) for git stash to be given by name (Windows' command-line limit, inside git); nothing was done. Keep git stash as it is: a command.

service.folderChanges.unplaced.text: Git didn't say which repository {folder} is in, so Combwork doesn't commit .gitignore while it can't check the agents working there. Try again.
service.folderChanges.unplaced.note: HI-2962: an error from Files' Commit it after Exclude from Git: a project folder ({folder}, a path) inside the same repository couldn't be placed by git (it answered nothing), so nothing was committed. Keep .gitignore: a file name.

service.folderChanges.wrongBranch.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside: the folder ({folder}, a path) is on another branch than {target} now; nothing was done.

service.forward.direction.text: {to} isn’t brought up to date with {from}: {why, select, older {{to} is an older version than {from}, and forward merges go from a release into the next version} default {{to} is the repository’s default branch, which a release reaches through its pull request} sameVersion {{from} and {to} name the same version, so which comes first can’t be told} other {Combwork can’t tell which of {from} and {to} comes first on the release path}}. Nothing was queued. {dir, select, backward {Bring {from} up to date with {to} instead, or, if you mean it, ask the Assistant with your explicit override.} other {If you mean it, ask the Assistant with your explicit override.}}
service.forward.direction.note: HI-2892: a forward merge refused: it would bring branch {to} up to date with branch {from} against the release path’s direction (forward merges go from a release, or main, into the next version). {why} says why (select: translate each; keep the keys): {to} is an older version, {to} is the repository’s default branch (main), the two names are the same version, or Combwork can’t order them. {dir}: backward (the reverse is the right way) or other. Branch names stay as they are.

service.forward.directionRetry.text: {card} isn’t merged again: its request recorded no override, and {why, select, older {{to} is an older version than {from}, and forward merges go from a release into the next version} default {{to} is the repository’s default branch, which a release reaches through its pull request} sameVersion {{from} and {to} name the same version, so which comes first can’t be told} other {Combwork can’t tell which of {from} and {to} comes first on the release path}}. Remove it from the queue; to merge it anyway, ask the Assistant with your explicit override.
service.forward.directionRetry.note: HI-2892: Retry merge refused on a forward-merge card ({card}: its key, such as HI-12) that brings branch {to} up to date with branch {from} against the release path’s direction, its request made without the user’s override. {why} as in the refused request (select: translate each; keep the keys). Remove from queue is the card’s command: as translated there.

service.forward.missing.text: {unknown, select, yes {Combwork can’t read the branch {branch}, so nothing was queued.} other {There is no branch {branch} in this repository, so nothing was queued.}}
service.forward.missing.note: HI-2679: a forward merge refused: one of its branches doesn’t exist (or git couldn’t say). Keep the select keys.

service.forward.noGit.text: This project merges no work through Combwork’s merge queue, so it has nothing to bring up to date.
service.forward.noGit.note: HI-2679: a forward merge asked of a project that isn’t a Git project merging through the queue.

service.forward.notAgents.text: Only the user or the Assistant brings one branch up to date with another.
service.forward.notAgents.note: HI-2679: a forward merge refused: asked by a project agent or a script.

service.forward.notReturned.text: {card} isn’t a forward merge the merge queue sent back, so there is nothing to resolve on a builder.
service.forward.notReturned.note: HI-2959: Resolve on a builder refused: the card ({card}: its key) isn’t a forward merge card waiting after a conflict or a red check (it is queued, merging, Done, or an ordinary card).

service.forward.notTargets.text: {from} can’t be brought into {to}: {to} must be a branch this project merges work into ({targets}), and {from} another branch of {sources}.
service.forward.notTargets.note: HI-2679, HI-2885: a forward merge refused: {to} isn’t one of the project’s branches (Work merges into, Other branches work can merge into: {targets}, a list), {from} isn’t one of those or the repository’s default branch ({sources}, a list), or the two are the same branch.

service.forward.openNoOverride.text: {card} is bringing {to} up to date with {from} already, without an override, so the override wasn’t applied to it: remove it from the queue first, then ask again.
service.forward.openNoOverride.note: HI-2892: a forward merge asked with the user’s explicit override while a card ({card}: its key) for the same pair of branches ({from} into {to}) is open already, made without one: nothing changed.

service.forward.raced.text: The forward merge’s card changed while it was being queued, so nothing more was done: look at the card, then ask again if needed.
service.forward.raced.note: HI-2679: a forward merge whose new card was changed (started, moved) before it could be queued; rare.

service.forward.resolveRaced.text: {card} changed while it was being handed to a builder (a Retry, a Remove or another Resolve), so nothing was made: look at the card, then ask again if needed.
service.forward.resolveRaced.note: HI-2959: Resolve on a builder stopped part way because the forward merge card ({card}: its key) changed meanwhile; nothing was kept.

service.fsutil.keptBusy.text: {file} is being saved by something else: nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
service.fsutil.keptBusy.note: An error: one of Combwork's settings or records files ({file}: its path) was still being written by another program (an editor, a script), so Combwork's change to it wasn't made.

service.fsutil.keptUnreadable.text: {file} couldn't be read: nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
service.fsutil.keptUnreadable.note: An error: one of Combwork's settings or records files ({file}: its path) is there but couldn't be read (another program had it locked, or a disk error), so Combwork's change to it wasn't made and the file was left as it is.

service.fsutil.notCopied.note: An error putting back one of Combwork's skills or modes: its copy couldn't be made ({name}: its folder or file name); nothing was replaced.

service.git.exitCode.note: Why a git command failed when git said nothing: the number it exited with.

service.git.failed.note: An error in the Changes tab: a git command ({command}, as it is: "git status") failed; {why} is git's own first line, or why git can't run.

service.git.gitlinkUnread.text: Couldn't read which commit submodule {path} is at.
service.git.gitlinkUnread.note: An error in the Changes tab (HI-2864): git's output about a submodule's commit ({path}, its folder) couldn't be read, so its change isn't shown. Glossary: submodule.

service.git.outside.note: An error showing a file's changes: its path leads out of the project.

service.gitCompare.noBranch.text: There's no branch {branch} here any more.
service.gitCompare.noBranch.note: An error comparing two branches in the Changes tab: the branch {branch} was deleted or renamed since the list was read.

service.gitRepo.addFailed.note: An error adding the remote {remote} in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.badName.text: {kind, select, tag {{hasName, select, yes {{name} isn't a valid tag name.} other {That isn't a valid tag name.}}} other {{hasName, select, yes {{name} isn't a valid branch name.} other {That isn't a valid branch name.}}}}
service.gitRepo.badName.note: An error creating a branch or a tag ({kind}): its name {name} is one git refuses. {hasName} is no when no name was given (then it says That).

service.gitRepo.branchTaken.note: HI-2807: an error creating a branch: the repository has a branch called {name} already.

service.gitRepo.chooseRemote.text: Choose the remote to push to.
service.gitRepo.chooseRemote.note: An error pushing in the Git view: the repository has several remotes and none was chosen.

service.gitRepo.command.note: An error in the Git view: a git command ({command}, as it is: "git log") failed; {why} is git's own words, or why git can't run.

service.gitRepo.createFailed.note: An error creating the branch or tag {name}; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.detachedPull.text: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch to pull.
service.gitRepo.detachedPull.note: An error pulling in the Git view: the project folder is on no branch (a detached HEAD: keep HEAD as it is).

service.gitRepo.detachedPush.text: HEAD is detached: switch to a branch to push.
service.gitRepo.detachedPush.note: An error pushing in the Git view: the project folder is on no branch (a detached HEAD: keep HEAD as it is).

service.gitRepo.diverged.text: {branch} and {upstream} have diverged ({ahead, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} here, {behind, number} there), so pulling needs a merge or rebase. Do that in a terminal, or ask an agent to.
service.gitRepo.diverged.note: An error pulling in the Git view: the branch {branch} has {ahead} commits the remote branch {upstream} hasn't, and it has {behind} the branch hasn't; Combwork pulls only when no merge is needed.

service.gitRepo.exitCode.note: Why a git command failed when git said nothing: the number it exited with.

service.gitRepo.fetchFailed.note: An error fetching from the repository's remotes; {why} is git's own words (any password in a URL hidden).

service.gitRepo.gaveUp.text: git gave up after {minutes} minutes (no answer from the remote, or a sign-in left open).
service.gitRepo.gaveUp.note: Why fetching, pulling or pushing failed: git waited {minutes} minutes for the remote (or a sign-in window) and stopped.

service.gitRepo.inWorktree.text: {branch} is checked out in another worktree ({folder}): a branch can be in only one folder at a time.
service.gitRepo.inWorktree.note: An error switching branch in the Git view: the branch {branch} is checked out in the worktree {folder}.

service.gitRepo.midOperation.text: Git is in the middle of a {state}: finish or abort it first.
service.gitRepo.midOperation.note: An error pulling in the Git view: a git operation is under way in the project folder; {state} is git's word for it (merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert or bisect: keep it as it is).

service.gitRepo.noBranch.note: An error in the Git view (switching branch, choosing what a branch tracks): the repository has no branch called {branch}.

service.gitRepo.noCommits.text: The repository has no commits yet: commit something first.
service.gitRepo.noCommits.note: An error creating a branch in a repository with no commit yet.

service.gitRepo.noRemote.note: An error pushing or tagging: the repository has no remote called {remote}.

service.gitRepo.noRemotes.text: This repository has no remotes: add one first.
service.gitRepo.noRemotes.note: An error pushing in the Git view: the repository has no remote.

service.gitRepo.noRemotesFetch.text: This repository has no remotes to fetch from: add one first.
service.gitRepo.noRemotesFetch.note: An error fetching in the Git view: the repository has no remote.

service.gitRepo.noStart.text: There’s no branch, tag or commit {ref}.
service.gitRepo.noStart.note: HI-2807: an error creating a branch from a start point: nothing in the repository is called {ref} (as typed in Starts at).

service.gitRepo.noTarget.text: There's no branch {target} here to check the branches against.
service.gitRepo.noTarget.note: An error deleting branches in Version Control → Branches & remotes: the branch the project's work merges into ({target}; the default branch when none is set) isn't in the repository, so Combwork can't tell which branches are merged.

service.gitRepo.noUpstream.text: {branch} tracks no remote branch: push it first, or switch to one that does.
service.gitRepo.noUpstream.note: An error pulling in the Git view: the branch {branch} follows no remote branch.

service.gitRepo.notOnRemote.text: {remote} has no {branch} (as of the last fetch): push it there first, or fetch.
service.gitRepo.notOnRemote.note: An error choosing what a branch tracks in the Git view: the remote {remote} has no branch {branch} that Combwork knows of.

service.gitRepo.notRepo.note: An error in the Git view: the project folder {folder} is not in a git repository.

service.gitRepo.nothingToPush.text: The repository has no commits yet: nothing to push.
service.gitRepo.nothingToPush.note: An error pushing in the Git view: the repository has no commit yet.

service.gitRepo.nothingToTag.text: The repository has no commits yet: nothing to tag.
service.gitRepo.nothingToTag.note: An error tagging in the Git view: the repository has no commit yet.

service.gitRepo.pullFailed.note: An error pulling in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.pushAllRefused.text: {remote} refused {n, plural, one {# branch or tag} other {# branches and tags}} (Combwork never forces a push): it has commits they haven't, so pull or merge them first. What happened to each:
service.gitRepo.pushAllRefused.note: An error after Push to… with all branches and tags in the Git view: the first line, the remote {remote} refused {n} of them; a line for each outcome follows (service.gitRepo.pushOutcome).

service.gitRepo.pushFailed.note: An error pushing to the remote branch {to} in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.pushedAll.text: Pushed every branch and tag to {remote}:
service.gitRepo.pushedAll.note: After Push to… with all branches and tags in the Git view: the first line, what went to the remote {remote}; a line for each outcome follows (service.gitRepo.pushOutcome).

service.gitRepo.rejected.text: {to} has commits {branch} hasn't, so the push was refused (Combwork never forces a push). Pull first, or merge them in a terminal.
service.gitRepo.rejected.note: An error pushing the branch {branch} in the Git view: the remote branch {to} has commits it hasn't, so the remote refused.

service.gitRepo.remoteBranchesDeleted.text: {n, plural, one {Deleted {branches} on {remote}.} other {Deleted # branches on {remote}: {branches}.}}
service.gitRepo.remoteBranchesDeleted.note: After deleting branches on the remote {remote} (Clean Up Merged Branches): {branches} lists them ({n}).

service.gitRepo.remoteDeleteRefused.text: {remote} refused to delete {branches}: it has commits there you haven't fetched, or it doesn't allow deleting them.
service.gitRepo.remoteDeleteRefused.note: After deleting branches on the remote {remote}: it refused those listed in {branches} (Combwork deletes a remote branch only at the commit you were shown).

service.gitRepo.remoteTaken.text: There is a remote called {remote} already.
service.gitRepo.remoteTaken.note: An error renaming a remote in the Git view: another remote has that name ({remote}).

service.gitRepo.remoteTrackingChanged.text: The branches tracking {remote} changed since you were asked, so nothing was removed: look at them again.
service.gitRepo.remoteTrackingChanged.note: An error removing a remote in the Git view: the local branches tracking it are not the ones the confirmation listed (one started or stopped tracking it meanwhile).

service.gitRepo.removeRemoteFailed.note: An error removing the remote {remote} in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.renameRemoteFailed.note: An error renaming the remote {remote} in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.setFailed.note: An error setting the repository's commit identity in the Git view: the git setting {key} (user.name or user.email: keep it) couldn't be set; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.startMoved.text: {ref} has moved since you were shown it (it’s at {now} now), so nothing was created: look at it again.
service.gitRepo.startMoved.note: HI-2807: an error creating a branch from a branch: {ref} points at another commit ({now}, a short hash) than the one the dialog showed.

service.gitRepo.switchFailed.note: An error switching the project folder to the branch {branch}; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.tagPushFailed.text: Tagged {commit} {name}, but couldn't push it to {remote}: {why}
service.gitRepo.tagPushFailed.note: An error in the Git view: the commit {commit} was tagged {name}, but pushing the tag to the remote {remote} failed; {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.tagTaken.text: There’s a tag {name}: a branch of the same name would make the name mean two things to git.
service.gitRepo.tagTaken.note: HI-2807: an error creating a branch: the repository has a tag called {name}, so a branch can’t take that name.

service.gitRepo.update.agentBusy.text: {agent} {status, select, starting {is starting} working {is working} waiting {is waiting for your answer} background {is waiting on background tasks it started} watching {is waiting for cards to change (a card watch)} other {stopped in the middle of a task when its sign-in expired}} in {folder}: update {branch} once it has finished.
service.gitRepo.update.agentBusy.note: Why updating a branch from its target is refused now: an agent works in the folder the branch is checked out in ({folder}: a slot's name, such as slot-a, or a folder's name or path). {agent} is the agent's name; {status} what it is doing (select: translate each); {branch} the branch.

service.gitRepo.update.conflict.text: {how, select, rebase {Rebasing} other {Merging}} {branch} with {target} stopped at a conflict in {files}, so it was undone: {branch} is as it was. Update it by hand, or ask its builder to.
service.gitRepo.update.conflict.note: An error updating a branch from its target: git stopped at a conflict, and Combwork aborted it, leaving the branch and its folder as they were. {how}: merge or rebase (select: translate each); {branch} the branch, {target} the target; {files} the files in conflict, joined (src/a.ts and src/b.ts).

service.gitRepo.update.dirty.text: {folder} has uncommitted changes: commit them, or set them aside, before updating {branch}.
service.gitRepo.update.dirty.note: Why updating a branch from its target is refused: the folder it is checked out in ({folder}: a slot's name, a folder's name or a path) has changes not committed. {branch} is the branch.

service.gitRepo.update.failed.text: Couldn't update {branch} from {target}, so it is as it was: {why}
service.gitRepo.update.failed.note: An error updating a branch from its target that isn't a conflict (a hook refused the commit, signing failed…); Combwork undid what git started. {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.update.isTarget.note: An error updating a branch from its target: the branch picked ({branch}) is the target.

service.gitRepo.update.midOperation.text: Git is in the middle of a {state} in {folder}: finish or abort it first.
service.gitRepo.update.midOperation.note: Why updating a branch from its target is refused: a git operation ({state}: merge, rebase…, as git names it) is under way in the folder the branch is checked out in ({folder}: a slot's name, a folder's name or a path).

service.gitRepo.update.missed.text: {branch} was changed, but it still lacks commits of {target}: check it in History before going on.
service.gitRepo.update.missed.note: An error after Update from <target> (HI-1180): git said it succeeded, but the branch {branch} still doesn't contain the target {target}'s head.

service.gitRepo.update.moved.text: {branch} changed while it was being updated, so nothing was changed: try again.
service.gitRepo.update.moved.note: An error updating a branch from its target: the branch moved to another commit meanwhile (a commit, a push), so Combwork left it as it is.

service.gitRepo.update.noTarget.text: The project has no target branch here, so there is nothing to update {branch} from.
service.gitRepo.update.noTarget.note: An error updating a branch from its target (Version Control → Branches, HI-1180): the project's workflow target (or the repository's default branch) doesn't exist in this repository. {branch} is the branch.

service.gitRepo.update.notUndone.text: Updating {branch} from {target} stopped, and Combwork couldn't undo it: {folder} is {state, select, none {left changed} merge {still in the middle of a merge} rebase {still in the middle of a rebase} other {still in the middle of a git operation}}. Finish or abort it there yourself (git status says how), then check {branch}. Git said: {why}
service.gitRepo.update.notUndone.note: An error updating a branch from its target (HI-1180): git stopped, and Combwork's own abort failed, so the folder ({folder}: a slot's name, a folder's name or a path) is left as git left it ({state}: none, merge, rebase or another operation; select: translate each). {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.update.notUndoneTemporar.text: Updating {branch} from {target} stopped, and Combwork couldn't undo it in its temporary folder {folder}, kept as git left it: {branch} itself is as it was. Remove that folder in Unused worktrees once you have looked. Git said: {why}
service.gitRepo.update.notUndoneTemporar.note: An error updating a branch from its target (HI-1180) that was checked out nowhere: git stopped in the temporary folder Combwork made ({folder}: its path), and Combwork's abort failed, so the folder is kept; the branch itself wasn't moved. {state} is unused here. {why} is git's own words.

service.gitRepo.update.queued.text: {card} is in the merge queue, which brings it up to date itself: take it out of the queue first to update {branch} here.
service.gitRepo.update.queued.note: Why updating a branch from its target is refused: the branch is the line of a card ({card}: its key, such as HI-12) that Combwork's merge queue is merging now. {branch} is the branch.

service.gitRepo.update.temporaryLeft.text: Combwork couldn't remove its temporary folder {folder}: remove it in Unused worktrees.
service.gitRepo.update.temporaryLeft.note: A second line after Update from <target> on a branch checked out nowhere (HI-1180): the temporary folder Combwork made for it ({folder}: its path) could not be removed.

service.gitRepo.upstreamGone.note: An error pulling in the Git view: the remote branch {upstream} the branch follows was deleted there.

service.gitRepo.urlFailed.note: An error changing the address of the remote {remote} in the Git view; {why} is git's own words.

service.intent.noWorkflow.text: {card} has no workflow: it is a card about the workspace, or its project has no version control chosen yet. Move it on the board instead.
service.intent.noWorkflow.note: An error: an intent (a card's start, submission, verdict…) was asked for a card that has no workflow, because it belongs to no project or its project's version control (Git or None) isn't chosen yet. {card} is the card's key (HI-12).

service.intent.queueNotAgents.text: Only the user, or the Assistant within Settings → Assistant → Control, takes a card out of the merge queue or retries its merge.
service.intent.queueNotAgents.note: An error: an agent or a script asked to remove a card from the merge queue or retry its merge, which only the user and the Combwork Assistant (within its Control setting, a setting name: use it as Combwork shows it) can do.

service.keys.closed.text: The workspace was closed, or the window opened another, before the key was changed: nothing changed.
service.keys.closed.note: An error changing a project's key: its workspace closed (or the window switched to another workspace) while the change waited; nothing was changed.

service.keys.form.text: A project key is 2 to 4 letters, A to Z.
service.keys.form.note: An error changing a project's key (Project Settings): the key typed isn't 2–4 letters A–Z.

service.keys.prefix.text: {key} and another project’s key {other} begin alike: no key can be the start of another.
service.keys.prefix.note: An error changing a project's key: {key} and another project's key {other} (both letters such as AM and AMB) would be one the start of the other, which isn't allowed.

service.keys.taken.text: {key} is another project’s key, or was: a key stays with its project for good.
service.keys.taken.note: An error changing a project's key: {key} (letters such as AM) belongs to another project now or did before (its old keys stay its aliases).

service.keys.unknownProject.text: That project has no id yet, so it can’t have a key: open it in Combwork first.
service.keys.unknownProject.note: An error changing a project's key: the project hasn't been given Combwork's id (it hasn't been opened yet).

service.laneEdit.already.note: HI-2898: an error adding a card ({card}, its key) to a lane (Progress → Lanes) that already has it.

service.laneEdit.cardChanged.text: {card} changed since (it was given to an agent, moved or edited): the change wasn’t undone.
service.laneEdit.cardChanged.note: HI-2898: an error undoing an edit of lanes (Progress → Lanes) that took a card ({card}, its key) from an agent: the card changed since, so nothing was undone.

service.laneEdit.changed.text: The cards of {lane} changed meanwhile: look again, then try again.
service.laneEdit.changed.note: HI-2898: an error editing a lane's cards in Progress → Lanes (a lane: a builder and a reviewer agent working through cards in turn): the lane's list changed since the window showed it (an agent, the Assistant or another window changed it), so nothing was changed. {lane} is its builder / reviewer (B1 / R1).

service.laneEdit.dependency.text: {card} depends on {dep}, which would come after it: put {dep} first.
service.laneEdit.dependency.note: HI-2898: an error moving or adding a card in a lane's cards (Progress → Lanes): {card} (a key) depends on {dep} (a key: it's blocked by it), and the change would put {dep} later in the lane.

service.laneEdit.done.note: HI-2898: an error adding a card ({card}, its key) to a lane (Progress → Lanes): it's already Done.

service.laneEdit.ended.text: {lane} has ended: its cards can’t be changed any more.
service.laneEdit.ended.note: HI-2898: an error editing a lane's cards in Progress → Lanes: the lane ended (or was abandoned) meanwhile. {lane} is its builder / reviewer, or its id when it's gone.

service.laneEdit.fixedPlace.text: Cards already started or finished keep their places: {card} can only go after them.
service.laneEdit.fixedPlace.note: HI-2898: an error moving or adding a card in a lane's cards (Progress → Lanes) to a place before a card that's already in progress, in review, approved or done ({card}: the card moved or added, its key).

service.laneEdit.invalid.text: That change of a lane’s cards isn’t one Combwork can make.
service.laneEdit.invalid.note: HI-2898: an error, a change of a lane's cards sent by the window (Progress → Lanes) was malformed (a mistake in Combwork, or a window from another version). Rarely seen.

service.laneEdit.keptWork.text: {card} keeps work from an earlier start (a branch, a slot or a run): it stays where it is. Carry it on from its card instead.
service.laneEdit.keptWork.note: HI-2898: an error adding a card ({card}, its key) to a lane, or moving it to another lane (Progress → Lanes): it was started before and its work is kept (a branch, a slot lent for it, or a run in progress), so Combwork won't hand it to another builder from here.

service.laneEdit.noQueued.text: {lane} has no queued change to cancel.
service.laneEdit.noQueued.note: HI-2898: an error cancelling a lane's queued change (Progress → Lanes: a change of its cards waiting for its card in progress to be Done) when it has none any more. {lane} is its builder / reviewer.

service.laneEdit.notOnLane.text: {card} isn’t on this lane any more.
service.laneEdit.notOnLane.note: HI-2898: an error moving or removing a card ({card}, its key) in a lane's cards (Progress → Lanes) that the lane no longer has.

service.laneEdit.notQueued.text: {card} has started, or isn’t to do any more: only cards still waiting their turn can be moved or taken off.
service.laneEdit.notQueued.note: HI-2898: an error moving or removing a card ({card}, its key) in a lane's cards (Progress → Lanes): only cards still waiting in To do, not another agent's, can be; this one is in progress, in review, approved, done, on hold or another agent's.

service.laneEdit.notTodo.text: {card} isn’t in To do: only cards not started yet join a lane.
service.laneEdit.notTodo.note: HI-2898: an error adding a card ({card}, its key) to a lane (Progress → Lanes): it's in progress, in review, approved or on hold. To do is the board's column of cards not started (as the board names it).

service.laneEdit.onLane.text: {card} is on the lane of {builder}: take it off there first, or use Move here.
service.laneEdit.onLane.note: HI-2898: an error adding a card ({card}, its key) to a lane (Progress → Lanes): another running lane (of the builder agent {builder}) has it. Move here is the button beside this message that moves it: as it's translated there.

service.laneEdit.otherProject.text: {card} isn’t one of {project}’s cards, or it’s archived.
service.laneEdit.otherProject.note: HI-2898: an error adding a card ({card}, its key) to a lane (Progress → Lanes): it belongs to another project than the lane's ({project}), or it's archived.

service.laneEdit.since.text: Ended lanes are listed from a time in the last two days.
service.laneEdit.since.note: HI-2898: an error, the window asked for the lanes that ended since a time that isn't a time in the last 48 hours (a mistake in Combwork). Rarely seen.

service.laneStart.busy.text: {status, select, working {Agent {agent} is working.} starting {Agent {agent} is starting.} waiting {Agent {agent} is waiting for your answer.} background {Agent {agent} is waiting on background tasks it started.} signin {Agent {agent} needs you to sign in again.} other {Agent {agent} is waiting on cards (a card watch).}} Start the lane once it's idle, or choose another agent.
service.laneStart.busy.note: An error starting a lane from the window: the agent {agent} can't start in a new conversation now, because of what it is doing ({status}; keep the select keys). The window offers to wait until it's idle. Each {status} a whole sentence with a noun before the name (HI-1585: glossary §1 rules 3 and 4).

service.laneStart.done.note: An error starting a lane from the window: a card chosen ({card}, its key) is already Done.

service.laneStart.needsReviewer.text: {project}'s rules have a reviewer agent review each card: choose a reviewer.
service.laneStart.needsReviewer.note: An error starting a lane from the window: the project's workflow options have a reviewer agent review the work, and no reviewer was chosen.

service.laneStart.noCards.text: Choose the cards for the lane.
service.laneStart.noCards.note: An error starting a lane (a builder and a reviewer working through cards in turn) from the window: no card was chosen.

service.laneStart.notTheProjects.text: {card} isn't one of {project}'s cards, or it is archived.
service.laneStart.notTheProjects.note: An error starting a lane from the window: a card chosen ({card}, its key) isn't this project's ({project}), or is archived.

service.laneStart.poolEmpty.text: None of {project}'s agents besides the builder reviews, so the pool has nobody to review the cards.
service.laneStart.poolEmpty.note: An error starting a lane from the window with the reviewer pool chosen: no agent of the project other than the builder has a role that reviews (Reviewer or Either).

service.laneStart.poolNotOffered.text: {project}'s rules have one reviewer per lane: choose a reviewer, or set Reviewers to a shared pool.
service.laneStart.poolNotOffered.note: An error starting a lane from the window with the reviewer pool chosen: the project's workflow options (G17, “Reviewers”, a value “A shared pool”) don't have a pool, or workflow rules are off.

service.laneStart.sameAgent.text: The builder can't be its own reviewer.
service.laneStart.sameAgent.note: An error starting a lane from the window: the same agent was chosen as builder and reviewer.

service.laneStart.starting.text: The lane of agent {agent} is being started already.
service.laneStart.starting.note: An error starting a lane from the window: one with the same builder ({agent}) is being started right now. A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

service.laneStart.unknownAgent.note: An error starting a lane from the window: the builder or reviewer chosen ({agent}) isn't an agent of the project ({project}).

service.lanes.noWorkspace.note: An error changing a workspace's lanes (card loops) while no workspace is open in the window.

service.lanes.targetBuilder.text: A lane’s Merges into is set by the user or the Assistant, not its builder.
service.lanes.targetBuilder.note: HI-2556: an error, a lane’s own builder agent named the branch its lane merges into; only the user or the Combwork Assistant (or a script) sets it.

service.lanes.targetCard.text: {card} merges into {cardTarget}, and this lane into {target}: a lane’s cards merge where it does. Leave it out, or start it in a lane of its own.
service.lanes.targetCard.note: HI-2556: an error putting a card whose own Merges into is another branch than the lane’s into that lane. {card} is the card’s key (HI-12); {cardTarget} and {target} are branch names.

service.lanes.targetFixed.text: {builder}’s lane merges into {target} until it ends: start a new lane for another branch. Once {target} has been merged into another branch, a retarget of Work merges into moves the lane and its card there (Also retarget what can move).
service.lanes.targetFixed.note: HI-2556, HI-2753: an error changing a running lane’s Merges into (fixed for its life, except through a retarget once its branch has been merged into another). {builder} is the lane’s builder agent, {target} its branch. Work merges into and Also retarget what can move are names in the window (Version Control → Workflow, Save…): as translated there.

service.lanes.targetMissing.text: {unknown, select, yes {Combwork can’t tell whether the branch {target} exists, so the lane wasn’t started.} other {There is no branch {target} in this repository: make it first, then start the lane on it.}}
service.lanes.targetMissing.note: HI-2556: an error starting a lane (a card loop) on a branch the project lists under Other branches work can merge into but which doesn’t exist (yet) in the repository. {target} is the branch name. unknown yes: git couldn’t say. Keep the select keys.

service.lanes.targetNotListed.text: {hasTargets, select, yes {{target} isn’t a branch work can merge into here: name {default}{hasOthers, select, yes { or one of {others}} other {}}, or add it under Other branches work can merge into (Version Control → Workflow).} other {This project merges work into no branch Combwork can pick: a lane’s Merges into is for Git projects.}}
service.lanes.targetNotListed.note: HI-2556: an error starting a lane (a card loop) whose Merges into is a branch the project doesn’t list. {target} is the branch named, {default} the project’s Work merges into, {others} the others listed (a list). Other branches work can merge into and Version Control → Workflow are names in the window: as translated there. Keep the select keys.

service.lanes.targetRulesOff.text: A lane merges into another branch only while workflow rules are enforced (Settings → Advanced).
service.lanes.targetRulesOff.note: HI-2556: an error starting a lane with a Merges into other than the project’s while the switch “Workflow rules are enforced” (Settings → Advanced) is off.

service.lanes.teamPaused.text: The team is paused (before an update): resume the team first, then start the lane.
service.lanes.teamPaused.note: An error starting a lane (a card loop) while the user or the Combwork Assistant has paused the whole team before an update (HI-2081): nothing of a lane starts until the team resumes (Resume the Team, in the Progress panel's Lanes).

service.lanes.unknown.note: An error: there is no lane (a card loop) with the id {id}, perhaps removed meanwhile.

service.metrics.badProvider.text: provider must be a provider id
service.metrics.badProvider.note: An error reading metrics: the provider filter isn't a provider's id. Keep provider as it is (a parameter's name).

service.metrics.badRange.text: from and to must be ISO times, from before to
service.metrics.badRange.note: An error reading metrics: the range asked for is not two times in order. from and to are the parameters' names: keep them, and ISO.

service.metrics.badRole.text: role must be agent, assistant, api or viewer
service.metrics.badRole.note: An error reading metrics: the role filter isn't one of its values. Keep role, agent, assistant, api and viewer as they are (a parameter and its values).

service.nameUpgrade.boardNotFolded.text: Combwork couldn't rename the board's file {file} to combwork.db: its log {log} still holds changes after it was closed. Close any other program using the workspace, then open it again. Nothing was lost.
service.nameUpgrade.boardNotFolded.note: An error opening a workspace (HI-2587): the task board database, renamed combwork.db in this version, still had changes in its SQLite log beside it, so it was left as it is. {file} and {log} are file paths. Keep combwork.db as it is (a file name).

service.nameUpgrade.boardOrphan.text: The workspace's board file is missing, but {file} beside where it was holds changes that may be the only copy of them. Combwork won't start an empty board over it. Close Combwork, put the board's file back beside it under its old name, {old} (from .combwork\backups or another copy), then open the workspace again.
service.nameUpgrade.boardOrphan.note: An error opening a workspace (HI-2587): no task board database is there, but an SQLite log or journal of the old one is, holding data. {file} is its path; {old} is the board file's name from before 1.1. Keep .combwork\backups as it is (a folder name).

service.nameUpgrade.failed.text: Combwork couldn't finish renaming {what} from the old names to Combwork's: {error} Open the workspace again to finish. Nothing was lost.
service.nameUpgrade.failed.note: An error opening a workspace (HI-2587): a step of the one-time upgrade of the names the app stored before 1.1 (files, settings) to Combwork's failed; the next open tries again. {what} is what it was renaming (main.nameUpgrade.what.*); {error} says why, a sentence.

service.nextVersion.movedOn.text: Work merges into is {now} now, not {from}, so nothing was changed: look again.
service.nextVersion.movedOn.note: HI-2807: Start the next version refused: the project’s Work merges into (an option’s name: as translated there) changed from {from} to {now} since the dialog opened.

service.nextVersion.noName.text: Name the next version’s branch: {from} doesn’t read as a version to propose one from.
service.nextVersion.noName.note: HI-2807: Start the next version refused: no name was given, and the release branch {from} isn’t a version number (1.3.0), so none could be proposed.

service.nextVersion.notBranch.text: {from} isn’t a branch in this repository, so nothing can start from it.
service.nextVersion.notBranch.note: HI-2807: Start the next version refused: the project’s Work merges into, {from}, isn’t a local branch (a tag of that name doesn’t count).

service.nextVersion.notGit.text: Start the next version needs a project using Git.
service.nextVersion.notGit.note: HI-2807: Start the next version refused: the project’s version control isn’t Git. Start the next version is an action’s name: as translated there.

service.nextVersion.partial.text: Created {name} at {commit}, but the workflow options weren’t saved: {why} {name} was kept ({kept, select, moved {it has moved since} worktree {it is checked out} inUse {it is in use} gone {it is gone} other {it couldn’t be removed}}): delete it in Version Control if it isn’t wanted.
service.nextVersion.partial.note: HI-2807: Start the next version made the branch {name} (at {commit}, a short hash) but saving the options failed ({why}, a sentence), and the branch couldn’t be removed again, for the reason {kept} (keep the select keys).

service.nextVersion.sameName.text: The next version needs a branch of its own, not {from}.
service.nextVersion.sameName.note: HI-2807: Start the next version refused: the name given is the release branch’s own, {from}.

service.providers.noSetup.note: An error: the coding agent CLI {cli} ("Codex") has no setup task for Combwork to run.

service.providers.notInstalled.note: An error running a coding agent CLI's task (update, sign-in, setup): the CLI {cli} ("Codex") is not installed.

service.providers.retryUnavailable.text: This update retry is no longer available. Check again, then try Update.
service.providers.retryUnavailable.note: Provider Setup error when a user tries to retry an update whose failure is no longer current. Check again and Update are buttons.

service.providers.signInConnections.text: {cli} signs in per account: sign in from Settings → Accounts & Connections.
service.providers.signInConnections.note: An error: Provider Setup was asked to sign a coding agent CLI ({cli}: "Claude Code") in, but its logins are accounts (Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section).

service.providers.stillLooking.text: Combwork is still looking for {cli}. Try again in a moment.
service.providers.stillLooking.note: An error: Combwork hasn't finished finding the coding agent CLI {cli} ("Codex"), so it can't use it yet.

service.providers.stillLookingAll.text: Combwork is still looking for the coding agent CLIs. Try again in a moment.
service.providers.stillLookingAll.note: An error: Combwork hasn't finished finding the coding agent CLIs installed (it does when it starts), so it can't choose one yet.

service.providers.stopFirst.text: Stop all running {cli} agents before updating it.
service.providers.stopFirst.note: An error updating the coding agent CLI {cli} ("Codex") while agents run it.

service.providers.unknownHost.text: No project uses that GitHub host for {cli} now. Check again, then sign in.
service.providers.unknownHost.note: An error: Provider Setup was asked to sign a coding agent CLI ({cli}: "GitHub Copilot") in on a GitHub host none of the open projects uses any more (HI-2779). Check again is the button.

service.queue.catchUpNoCommit.text: {card} is merged and on {target}’s remote already: a commit here would put one on {target} that its remote doesn’t have. Set the changes aside instead, and {target} catches up.
service.queue.catchUpNoCommit.note: HI-2988: an error from Commit on a paused merge queue whose target follows its remote: the card ({card}: its key) is already merged and published, and the pause is the local branch ({target}) catching up with it; only Set Aside (a button’s name: as translated there) is offered.

service.queue.pauseChanged.text: The merge queue's pause changed meanwhile: nothing was committed or set aside. Look again.
service.queue.pauseChanged.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside on a paused merge: the pause shown is no longer the current one (resumed, or paused for something else).

service.queue.pauseNoFolder.text: Combwork doesn't know which folder these changes were in. Resume the queue: it looks again and says where.
service.queue.pauseNoFolder.note: HI-2944: an error from Commit or Set aside on a paused merge from before Combwork recorded the folder of such a pause: Resume makes the queue look again, and its new pause names the folder.

service.repoOps.notOffered.text: Version control ({platform}) doesn’t offer that here.
service.repoOps.notOffered.note: HI-2788: an error when the window asks to change a repository in a way its version control ({platform}: a version control’s name, as Combwork names it) doesn’t list. Not reached in 1.4.0: Git lists every operation.

service.slots.notPrepared.note: A notice: a card was started in a slot (a worktree Combwork lends to a card or a lane), and Combwork couldn't check out the card's branch there or install its dependencies. {slot} is the slot's name (slot-b), {card} the card's key, {why} git's or the setup's reason, in English.

service.slots.resumeFailed.text: Combwork couldn't resume {agent}'s conversation in {slot} for {card} (three tries): {why}. Resume {agent} from Sessions, or start it fresh, and Combwork gives it {card}.
service.slots.resumeFailed.note: A notice (HI-1746): a card was started for an agent (its builder) in a slot, and Combwork's resumes of the agent's last conversation there failed three times, so it stopped trying. Once the user resumes the agent, or starts it, Combwork hands it the card. {card} is the card's key, {agent} the agent's name, {slot} the slot's name (slot-b), {why} the last failure's reason, in English.

service.slots.resumeHeld.text: Combwork can't give {card} to {agent} yet: {agent}'s conversation in {slot} can't resume now ({why}). Combwork gives it {card} once it can.
service.slots.resumeHeld.note: A notice (HI-1746): a card was started for an agent (its builder) in a slot, and Combwork hasn't handed the card to it yet; the agent's last conversation, in that slot, can't be resumed now, and Combwork never starts a new conversation instead. {card} is the card's key, {agent} the agent's name, {slot} the slot's name (slot-b), {why} the reason, in English.

service.transcripts.busy.text: This session is being archived or deleted. Try again in a moment.
service.transcripts.busy.note: An error opening a session's conversation in the Sessions tab while it is being archived or deleted.

service.transcripts.imageNotKept.text: The image is not stored in the transcript
service.transcripts.imageNotKept.note: An error in the Sessions tab: the conversation's file mentions the image but doesn't hold it.

service.transcripts.noImage.note: An error in the Sessions tab: the image asked for isn't in the conversation (any more).

service.transcripts.noTool.note: An error in the Sessions tab: the tool call asked for isn't in the conversation (any more).

service.transcripts.none.text: This session has no transcript yet.
service.transcripts.none.note: An error in the Sessions tab: the session's CLI hasn't written its conversation's file yet.

service.workflow.changedMeanwhile.text: The workflow options changed meanwhile (in another window, or by the Assistant), so nothing was saved. The section shows them as they are now.
service.workflow.changedMeanwhile.note: Why saving the Workflow section of the Version Control tab was refused: the options changed after the section was read. It reloads them.

service.workflow.closed.text: The workspace this card belongs to has closed
service.workflow.closed.note: An error: a change to a card was asked for in a workspace that has since closed, or whose window opened another workspace.

service.workflow.inheritor.text: Project {project} inherits these options, and the change would make its options contradict each other:
service.workflow.inheritor.note: Why saving workflow defaults (Settings → Workflow defaults or Settings → Workspace) was refused: a project that inherits them would have contradictory options. The reason follows on its own line. {project} is its name.

service.workflow.targetInUse.text: {branch} can’t be taken out of Other branches work can merge into while these use it: {uses}. Retarget or finish them first.
service.workflow.targetInUse.note: HI-2680: a save of workflow options refused: it takes a branch out of Other branches work can merge into while cards, lanes, queue entries or slots still use it ({uses}: their keys and names). Other branches work can merge into is the option’s name: as translated there.

service.workflow.targetMissing.text: {n, plural, one {{branches} doesn’t exist} other {{branches} don’t exist}}, so nothing was saved: create {n, plural, one {it} other {them}} first (Version Control → New branch…).
service.workflow.targetMissing.note: HI-2807: a save of workflow options refused: Work merges into or Other branches work can merge into names branches ({branches}, {n} of them) the repository hasn’t got. New branch… is a button: as translated there.

service.workspace.advancedNotHere.text: {setting} can't be set for a workspace.
service.workspace.advancedNotHere.note: An error: the advanced setting {setting} (its title, or its id) has no value of its own for a workspace, only for Combwork.

service.workspace.agentGone.note: An error changing an agent's settings: it was removed meanwhile.

service.workspace.badName.text: Project names cannot start with "." or contain {chars}
service.workspace.badName.note: An error making a project: a project's name (its folder's) can't start with a dot or hold the characters {chars}, which Windows doesn't allow in a folder's name.

service.workspace.closed.note: An error: the workspace was closed (or the window opened another) while the action was under way.

service.workspace.connectionGone.text: The connection chosen for {agent} was removed, or is being removed. Choose another.
service.workspace.connectionGone.note: An error saving an agent (HI-2107): the connection chosen for it ({agent}, the agent's name) was removed from Settings → Accounts & Connections meanwhile.

service.workspace.folderExists.note: An error making a project: the workspace already has a folder called {name}.

service.workspace.holdsOpen.text: The workspace {workspace}, open in another window, is inside {folder}. Close it first to open {name} as a workspace.
service.workspace.holdsOpen.note: An error opening a workspace: another Combwork window's workspace {workspace} is inside the folder {folder} (its name: {name}).

service.workspace.insideOpen.text: {folder} is inside the workspace {workspace}, which is open in another window. Close that workspace first, or open this folder's projects from there.
service.workspace.insideOpen.note: An error opening a workspace: the folder {folder} is inside {workspace}, the workspace of another Combwork window (a workspace inside another would share its projects).

service.workspace.none.note: An error: the action needs a workspace, and none is open in this window.

service.workspace.notFound.note: An error opening a workspace: the folder {folder} is not there.

service.workspace.notProject.text: Not a project in the open workspace: {path}
service.workspace.notProject.note: An error: {path} isn't one of the open workspace's projects (a folder in it, not hidden).

service.workspace.notRoot.text: Not a project or agent worktree in the open workspace: {path}
service.workspace.notRoot.note: An error: {path} is neither one of the open workspace's projects nor the worktree of one of their agents.

service.workspace.openElsewhere.text: {folder} is already open in another window.
service.workspace.openElsewhere.note: An error opening a workspace: the folder {folder} is the workspace of another Combwork window.

service.workspace.stillClosing.text: {name} is still closing: wait for it to finish, then try again.
service.workspace.stillClosing.note: An error opening, making or closing a workspace while this window is still closing its workspace {name}.

service.workspace.stillOpening.text: {name} is still opening: wait for it to finish, then try again.
service.workspace.stillOpening.note: An error opening, making or closing a workspace while this window is still opening its workspace {name} (bringing its skills up to date, or upgrading it to 1.0).
